text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит runs as fast as she can
and
manages to barely win against
Нарита Таисин.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But it's not their heated rivalry that has
left an
impression on the spectators—all
the fans can
talk about is Taishin's
explosive sprinting.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит becomes motivated to
work even
harder, so as not to lose to
Нарита Таисин.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ever enthusiastic, she sets her sights on
the
Takarazuka Kinen, the race to
conclude the first
half of the Twinkle
Series.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
